**[Get WhisperShortcut on the Mac App Store](https://whispershortcut.com/go/appstore?src=github-release)** — automatic updates, one-time purchase.

## Chat models
- **New: Gemini 4 Argon** for Chat and Dictate Prompt, Google's flagship reasoning model for hard questions. Paid Gemini keys only.
- **Gemini 3.7 Flash removed.** Google now serves it as Gemini 3.8 Flash at the same price, so any place that used 3.7 Flash (Chat, Dictate Prompt, Dictate, Smart Improvement) moves to 3.8 Flash automatically.

## Chat commands
- **Delete a command from Settings.** Each command in Settings → Chat → Commands has a trash button. The file goes to the macOS Trash, and Undo brings it back.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.53...v8.54
